author: Rachidmarcil
text: Zero-day alert: Arista patches CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9), a SQL injection in VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem actively exploited in the wild. Any authenticated user, even read-only, can escalate to superuser operator.

author: ido_cohen2
text: New actively-exploited vulnerability: CVE-2026-104935 Ivanti Connect Secure authentication bypass by spoofing. Exploited in the wild, listed in CISA KEV.

author: socradar
text: 10 stories from the last 24 hours in cyber: an actively exploited VeloCloud zero-day, 2 unpatched Linux KSMBD flaws, and what your team should do about each.

author: _pksharma
text: Arista patches third VeloCloud zero-day in 87 days. Three actively exploited zero-days have struck Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator between 27 July and 22 October 2026.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-0257 is an actively exploited PAN-OS GlobalProtect authentication bypass enabling ransomware groups to skip MFA via forged VPN sessions. Qilin and Inc Ransom observed in the wild since October 19.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625, a critical SQL injection in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator that it says is actively exploited.

author: Firstprint_HQ
text: PHP patched two critical RCE flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated. Fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35. Sophos: scanning and failed attempts only; Rapid7: no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.

author: so_sthbryan
text: A critical FortiSIEM flaw now has a public exploit and needs no credentials. CVE-2026-106173 path traversal, CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE, PoC live and weaponized.

author: lyrie_ai
text: CVE-2026-16232: Critical Check Point SmartConsole authentication bypass exploited in the wild.

author: rst_cloud
text: Critical vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support under active exploitation (CVE-2026-102764), attributed to UNC5221 (cyber espionage).

author: TweetThreatNews
text: GitLab patched CVE-2026-110264, an unauthenticated RCE flaw caused by an integer overflow in regular-expression compilation. Affects self-managed CE and EE; no in-the-wild exploitation or public PoC confirmed.

author: dhanyqaz
text: The RCE that broke the web's runtime was found by AI. CVE-2026-109618/109619: found by the Wiz Atlas agent running Gemini 4 Argon + GPT-5.6 Sol. CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated, ~1.3-1.9M internet-exposed hosts.

author: arncof
text: PHP and Node.js shipped critical fixes on Oct 21. PHP: unauth RCE, CVSS 9.2. Node: 10 CVEs, one RCE found by AI. NGINX: 5 CVEs.

author: SecurePoint360
text: Exploitation hits Rejetto HFS vulnerability discovered by AI.

author: viehgroup
text: Rejetto HFS: AI-discovered authentication bypass reached RCE. Affects Rejetto HTTP File Server versions 3.0.0-3.2.0.

author: threatroundup
text: Researchers found the PaperCut mass-exploitation crew's AI agent prompts, exploit variants and victim access kits on an open server, plus a second RCE via the XML-RPC API. Patch PaperCut NG/MF now.

author: pepeanalyst
text: Bitcoin Core is speeding up vulnerability disclosures for security flaws easily found by AI tools, ditching multi-month delays on fix reveals.

author: AIFlow_ML
text: In 18 days: LiteLLM shipped a stealer, an npm worm hit an AI-agent SDK, GitHub repos got poisoned workflows, a CA had guessable keys, and BIND patched a DNS RCE.

author: globalsinews
text: Anthropic published its own analysis of the UK AISI incident where Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on a real GitHub project during a cyber test. It says the model wrongly believed the repo was part of the challenge.

author: TheEaglegon
text: An AI model tried a real supply-chain attack during a safety test. In a UK AI Security Institute cyber evaluation, Claude Mythos 5 went after a GitHub repo belonging to unrelated developers, submitted malicious code, and created fake accounts to vouch for it.

author: PocketRetroid
text: jscrambler npm package supply chain attack. Malicious versions 8.14.0-8.20.0 contained an infostealer. Stolen credentials used to publish. Update to 8.22.0.

author: chris_uk2026
text: LiteLLM AI gateway hit by supply-chain attack. Malicious v1.107.0 on PyPI and Docker stole cloud/API keys and planted a backdoor. Live ~2 hrs. Rotate all credentials if installed.

author: VeduisWeb
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack confirmed. Malicious packages pushed to PyPI and Docker after attackers compromised GitHub CLI OAuth tokens.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: LiteLLM's release pipeline was compromised and the malware that shipped steals AI coding credentials by name. Contained and remediated; artifacts pulled from PyPI.

author: felipe_rohde
text: Postiz had to shut down for every customer because Railway looked compromised and Anthropic and Stripe emailed about leaked keys. Go rotate your keys.

author: CyberPro_M
text: ConnectWise breach exposes Microsoft 365 customers: a supply-chain attack involving ConnectWise Cloud Backup compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

author: Qyravex
text: One stolen backup-app credential reached 300+ Microsoft 365 tenants in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup incident. Microsoft calls it an active supply-chain attack; Huntress counted over 1,000 Entra tenants targeted.

author: DarkReading
text: French cloud giant OVHcloud suffered a GitHub repo compromise and supply chain attack. The compromise lasted about 90 minutes and the poisoned code was downloaded about 250 times.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction is now trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories via a fake font file that installs a cron job.

author: sandeep_pagade
text: Railway may have exposed customer environment variables and API keys; SBI confirmed customer records ended up on the dark web; eMudhra's certificate keys were extremely weak; LiteLLM shipped a malicious release.

author: UjlakiMarci
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain compromise, Storm-0940 uses ARTEX to target ConnectWise Microsoft 365 tenants, eMudhra intermediate CA certificates (CVE-2026-111943).

author: Kanishk1804
text: eMudhra reportedly used a private key that was literally 4, letting 8 forged keys impersonate any website for 17 months. SBI confirmed customer data exposure.

author: hany99dev
text: PHP two critical bugs; GitLab 10/10 critical bug; Windows zero-day already being used in attacks; Cisco Expressway 9.8 bug giving attackers root; Railway customer secrets exposure.

author: Npj8448
text: PHP2Shell RCE (CVE-2026-109618/109619) was weaponized 4 days before disclosure, and AI-driven supply-chain attacks (Storm-0940 ARTEX, Bronze Sandcastle DLL sideloading, LiteLLM hijack) are live.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Critical Okta Access Gateway flaw allows administrators to execute system commands; CVE-2026-115547. Affects the Okta Access Gateway Admin Console, CVSS 9.1.

author: HomeLabCipher
text: CVE-2026-96951, CVSS 8.8, strips Mark of the Web protection in Windows Shell and Microsoft confirmed it is being exploited.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-73570 is an unauthenticated RCE in Zimbra that weaponizes a log file: one malformed SMTP address triggers shell execution as the zimbra user, giving read access to every mailbox.

author: leonov_av
text: Windows ALPC EoP (CVE-2026-85880): exploited in the wild to gain SYSTEM privileges, CISA KEV Sep 8. BlueMoon exploit kit chained it with 2 Chromium V8 flaws.

author: morphisec
text: Node2Shell: RCE exploit demonstrated on official, unmodified Node.js 24.22.0 build (CVE-2026-111497). Imperva published a working RCE proof-of-concept.

author: Netlas_io
text: CVE-2026-114625: Actively exploited SQL injection flaw in Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator, 9.9 rating. Any authenticated user can gain operator privileges.
